The TMR 6WI series is a new family of isolated 6 W DC/DC converter modules
with regulated output, featuring wide 4:1 input voltage ranges. The product
comes in a ultra-compact SIP-8 plastic package with a small footprint
occupying only 2.0 cm² (0.3 square inch) of board space.
An excellent efficiency allows –40° to +84°C operation temperatures. Further
features include remote On/Off control and continuous short circuit protection.
The very compact dimensions of these converters make them an ideal solution
for many space critical applications in communication equipment,
instrumentation and industrial electronics.
